assign.request: Color study: inventory tokens, measure usage, flag contrast failures, build page.js for theme-browser minion
steps: read styles/theme sources, build token table

log.msg: 29 color tokens in lew42.css (light-dark pairs + syn-*). Measured: 42 unique computed colors light / 36 dark across 15 pages. 8 light-stray / 5 dark-stray non-token colors; the recurring one is UA default link blue rgb(0,0,238)/rgb(158,158,255) x85 each - bare <a> outside :where(p,li,td,th,dd,blockquote,.md) and without a component class gets zero color rule.

Near-misses: a.tab 4.23:1, .demo-btn 4.26:1 (--subtle just under AA).

assign.outcome:
**Landed: [/imagine/design/color/](/imagine/design/color/)** — live inventory of lew42's 29 color tokens (light+dark swatches painted with real `var(--x)`, forced per-island via `color-scheme`), measured against 15 pages × 2 modes.

Key numbers: **29 tokens**, **42 unique computed colors in light mode / 36 in dark**, **8 / 5 hardcoded strays** (only one is a real repeated defect — a bare `<a>` outside `:where(p,li,td,th,dd,blockquote,.md)` with no component class falls to the browser's default link blue, 85× each mode). **7 unique real contrast failures** after dedup; worst is `.toc-link.current` / `.ai-card-title` painting `color: var(--prim)` as TEXT (2.01–2.25:1) — lew42.css's own comment already names this exact mistake (`--prim-ink` is the text-safe twin, 5.19:1+). `button.prim`'s 2.25:1 is excluded from that count — framework.css already documents and mitigates it.

Themability: **yes, one seam** (`.theme-lew42` class-swap) — 3 tokens are aliases a new theme can skip (`--syn-keyword/builtin/error` = `--prim`), 2 are shape-not-color decisions (`--card-shadow`/`--card-ring`), and `--code-bg`/`--code-ink`/`--syn-*` are deliberately flat, not `light-dark()` — the trap a new theme is likely to hit.

4 failure shots + 3 working shots in `shots/`, 504KB total. Left for later: didn't chase the two near-miss `.tab`/`.demo-btn` pairs (4.2×:1, a rounding error not a token problem) or fix `ai-card-title`/`toc-link` myself — this was a study, not a patch, and both are one-line `--prim` → `--prim-ink` fixes for whoever owns `ext/AITask` and `ext/toc`.
